idea-plugin.name: Dockerfile Layer Size Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the real, on-disk size of each COPY/ADD layer in an open Dockerfile, inline -- computed by summing the actual file sizes of what gets copied from your local build context, respecting .dockerignore. No Docker daemon, no build, no network call: 100% static analysis of the project already open in the IDE.

For RUN instructions, there is no way to know the real size a command will add to a layer without actually running it -- so this plugin never invents a number for RUN. Instead it flags well-documented, known-expensive patterns (apt-get install without --no-install-recommends, apt-get update without cleaning the package cache in the same instruction, pip install without --no-cache-dir, several separate RUN instructions that could be combined) with an honest "known-expensive pattern" label, never a fabricated size.

Multi-stage COPY --from=<stage> is recognized and labeled "not calculable without running the build" rather than silently guessing or crashing.

Free. 100% local -- no network call, no account, no telemetry.
